title: ESP Development Board
description: A dev board built on a module (or a bare SoC). Inherits radio/CPU specs through `module` -> `soc`. State exactly one of `module` or `soc`. Every added spec carries a source.

module.description: id of the module it uses (must exist in data/modules/)

soc.description: id of the SoC, when the board uses a bare chip (must exist in data/socs/)

price_tier.description: APPROXIMATE, EDITORIAL street-price bucket — NOT a datasheet-verified spec, exempt from the sources rule. Optional; omit rather than guess. Used only by the wizard's budget filter, never rendered alongside hard specs.

bridge.description: USB-UART bridge chip (e.g. cp2102, ch340) or 'native' if the SoC's own USB is used

display.description: e.g. '1.9in 170x320 IPS' — only if the board has an onboard display

extras.description: onboard peripherals: sd-card, imu, mic, rgb-led, gps, etc.

io.description: Usable GPIO exposure and external-load power delivery — board-level, vendor-sourced (SPEC-io-power.md §2). Every field cite-or-omit; absence is neutral, never inventive.

gpio_exposed.description: count of GPIO pads routed to a header/pin, as printed by the vendor (e.g. 'IO x6')

gpio_free.description: gpio_exposed minus the SoC's exposed reserved_pins (strapping/input-only/usb-flash-tied) and any pins hard-consumed onboard; DERIVED unless the vendor states it directly — record the subtraction in notes

gpio_pins.description: the GPIO numbers broken out to a user-accessible header (the raw exposed set, before subtracting reserved). Cited to the same pinout source as gpio_exposed/gpio_free; cite-or-omit.

input_only.description: count of exposed pads that are input-only (no output capability)
